# Inflict Wounds (`spells:inflict-wounds`)
**Level 1 [Necromancy](../magic-schools/necromancy.md)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S | **Duration:** Instantaneous | **Classes:** [Cleric](../classes/cleric.md)
**Damage Type:** [Necrotic](../damage-types/necrotic.md)

A creature you touch makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 1.

| Slot Level | Damage |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2d10 |
